title: fundamental_fetch_state row
description: Logical row for table fundamental_fetch_state (see shared/databases/migrations/009_fundamental_fetch_state.sql). Per-symbol, per-sub-task fetch checkpoint for data-fundamental, added so the universe-wide TTM metrics pass (~3.3 hours at the shared Finnhub rate) survives a restart. Deliberately a separate table from universe_symbols.backfill_* rather than a reuse of it: the two jobs want identically-shaped state, and that identical shape is exactly what would make a fundamentals failure indistinguishable from a bar failure in the one column an on-call reader would check. Spec: docs/MOMENTUM_SCANNER_PHASE1.md §8.4.

task.description: Which data-fundamental sub-task this row tracks. 'metrics' is the only widened task in Phase 1; the other seven still iterate the static symbol list and have no rows here. Part of the primary key, so the key itself is the lease granularity — a symbol whose metrics call succeeded and whose earnings call failed retries only earnings

claimed_at.description: Set when in_progress is claimed. A claim older than the configured lease is reclaimable — without it a worker killed mid-symbol would strand the row forever and the pass would silently finish incomplete

attempts.description: Incremented on failure only. Past the configured cap the row stops being claimed, so a permanently broken symbol stops consuming the shared Finnhub budget

last_error.description: Persisted so a stalled pass is diagnosable from SQL alone rather than by correlating logs. Truncated to 500 characters

completed_at.description: When the last attempt finished, successful or not

last_success_ts.description: When data was last actually stored. Distinct from completed_at on purpose: the weekly cadence is driven by how long since a symbol was genuinely refreshed, so a run of failures must not make it look fresh. Advanced only by MarkFundamentalFetchDone
